Outpatient clinic note, Alexandria
Date: 2025-03-19
Patient: synthetic case P020, 45-year-old male.

Problems:
History of chronic kidney disease stage 3a.
Known hyperlipidaemia.
- atrial fibrillation

Allergy: penicillin (rash).

Medications:
- levothyroxine 50 mcg mane, before food
- amlodipine 5mg OD
- lisinopril 10 mg OD
